# market-data-sanity-checker

> Trust layer for market data: validate, score and explain anomalies in OHLCV, dividends,
> splits and fundamentals — before they break your screener, dashboard or tracker.
> TypeScript library + CLI (`mdsc`), MIT licensed.

## Key facts

- Install: `npm install market-data-sanity-checker` (Node ≥ 20, zero config).
- CLI check: `mdsc check --file aapl.csv --symbol AAPL --source yahoo` or fetch directly
  with `mdsc check --provider yahoo --symbol AAPL --range 1y` (Yahoo is keyless;
  Alpha Vantage needs `ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY`).
- CLI compare: `mdsc compare --symbol AAPL --providers yahoo,alpha-vantage` (or
  `--files a.json,b.csv`) — multi-source divergence detection with a consistency score.
- Rule corpus: 36 rules — 29 single-source (price/OHLCV, corporate actions, fundamentals,
  metadata) plus 7 multi-source compare rules. Catalog: `mdsc rules --format json`.
- Sanity score: `max(0, 100 − Σ penalties)` — critical −40, warning −15, info −5; each
  rule penalizes once per dataset (repeated defects count as `occurrences`). Bands:
  90–100 reliable, 70–89 usable with caution, 40–69 suspicious, <40 not fit for production.
- Exit codes: `0` gate passed · `1` gate failed (critical findings, or
  `--fail-on`/`--min-score`) · `2` operational error (file unreadable, invalid flags,
  provider unavailable, invalid config).
- Flag, don't delete: the tool detects, explains and scores — it never rewrites data.
- Headline rules: `SPLIT_NOT_ADJUSTED` (Yahoo unadjusted splits = phantom −50% crashes),
  `PRICE_SPIKE_INTRADAY` (Berkshire-2024-style bad ticks), `CURRENCY_SCALE_SUSPECT` and
  `DIV_SCALE_100X` (pence/pounds ×100 errors), `SYMBOL_MAPPING_SUSPECT` (ticker reuse,
  ISIN checksum), `SPLIT_MISMATCH` (cross-source split disagreement).
- Every finding carries severity (critical/warning/info), recommended action
  (block/flag/review), DAMA dimension, causal explanation, evidence and references.
- CI gating: `--fail-on warning --min-score 80`; audit trail via `--save` + `mdsc history`;
  self-contained interactive HTML dashboards via `--html` (single offline file, no server).

- [README.md](README.md): quickstart, install, CLI/SDK usage, sanity score, full rule catalog, FAQ
- [docs/examples.md](docs/examples.md): real caught-in-the-wild cases with reproducible output

- [docs/fixtures.md](docs/fixtures.md): real-case fixtures anchoring the headline rules
- [scoreboard/README.md](scoreboard/README.md): weekly public provider audit, reproducible with `pnpm scoreboard`
